label: i91-prettyprinter-idempotent
expect: pretty-printing already-formatted source returns it byte-identical, which is what changed:false is derived from — response body uses CRLF line endings; prettyPrintSource normalises them to LF before comparing
note: POST already-formatted source; the response is byte-identical to the request (changed:false)
requestBody:
CLASS zcl_i91_probe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run IMPORTING iv_times TYPE i DEFAULT 1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i91_probe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run.
    DATA lv_x TYPE i.
    lv_x = 1.
    rv_total = lv_x * iv_times.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
